answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond and publish a verifiable trail of completed work before it can earn full rewards. New identities start in a lagoon pool with capped payouts, and their standing grows only as the delta between promised and delivered work stays near zero over many epochs, like a dune built grain by grain. A sybil attacker must fund a bond and fake a work history for each identity, so cost scales linearly with every fake, while honest newcomers enter cheaply and graduate by doing real work.
